anchors.event_window: US earnings, after market close today
anchors.refresh_note: Stage 2 spot ($87.92) and implied move (13.0%) as of 2026-09-04 were refreshed same-day (2026-09-08, ~15:53 UTC / 11:53 EDT, ahead of tonight's AMC print) via stockanalysis.com and optionslam.com.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: I expect a realised absolute move of ~8-11%, below the 13.14% straddle. Historical mean abs is 9.09% and median 8.71%, so the options are pricing a repeat of the last print's +12.95% tail. Direction is modestly favourable but magnitude looks rich.
key_drivers: Street bar on the quarter is trivially low vs four straight quarters of beats
The metric that matters is the FY27 raise and GTV growth, not headline EPS; Street is already near the top of guidance
Valuation/positioning no longer stretched (7.54x EV/Sales, -26.7% 52wk) but guided margin steps down on Max/AI R&D spend
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: GTV decelerates through 20% on soft residential HVAC replacement volumes while the guided margin step-down lands as guided — a revenue beat then reads as 'growth slowing and they're spending into it'.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No primary 30/60/90-day estimate-revision breadth table found.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: 13.14% implied is rich outright, but asymmetric: up-prints matched/exceeded implied while down-prints ran only about half of implied. Expect realised ~8-11% with fat tail on the up side.
key_drivers: Positioning de-risked not crowded: short interest down ~27% m/m, borrow near-free
Options call-skewed against a falling tape: put/call 0.35 vs 0.55 20-day avg, 1.6:1 call volume
Drawdown into print is sector-wide AI de-rating, not idiosyncratic
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Bull case already expressed in options, not stock; a clean beat with in-line guide has no forced buyer left and gets sold into vol crush, as happened after the June gap.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No strike-level OI, skew, or dealer gamma; short-interest figures disagree across vendors.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Implied 13.1% above nearly every realised move. Expect ~9-11%. Up-moves have been larger than down-moves historically; positioning looks cleaned out, not piled in.
key_drivers: Not hyped: thin StockTwits volume, no meme/promotion risk
Sell-side bullish but lagging with serial PT cuts through 2026, partial post-Q1 rebuild
Company narrative (Max AI adoption, guide beat) concrete and checkable vs generic bear sector story
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: De-rating is a multiple story not an earnings story; TTAN has beaten all year and still round-tripped every gain including the entire June pop.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No dated 7/14/30-day sentiment time series available.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Base rate ±8-10% absolute vs 13.14% implied, ~45% rich. Direction close to coin flip (4 up/2 down of 6, not statistically distinguishable from 50/50); size looks over-priced.
key_drivers: 4-of-6 up is a lean not a signal (p~0.34)
Asymmetric payoff shape: downside capped near -7%, upside twice reached double digits
Gap-and-drift unreliable here; both large up-gaps faded materially in following weeks
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: TTAN has beaten every quarter (6/6) and still fell twice on conservative-reading guides; growth has decelerated 25%->21%->24-25%.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Sample only 6 quarters (below 8-observation threshold), Low confidence.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: 13.14% implied spans CPI (Sep 11) and FOMC (Sep 15-16) too, so pure earnings-day component is less than 13%. Expect realised ~8-11%; event-day vol fully priced to slightly rich, direction skew modestly up.
key_drivers: Closest vertical-SaaS peers (Samsara, Procore) paid violently for beat-and-raise this season despite de-rated tape
End-market read-through soft but mixed (Lennox/Watsco weak, Home Depot steady)
Macro backdrop hostile (10Y 4.79%, ~52% odds of a Fed hike, oil elevated) but TTAN already de-risked into it
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Klaviyo/Figma pattern repeating: revenue beat but opex/margin step-up converts fundamental beat into double-digit down move, especially with CPI/FOMC right after.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No TTAN-specific ETF/index flow or options positioning skew sourced.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: 13.14% implied at the very top of the realised distribution. Expect ~8-11% realised; straddle priced rich-to-fair, not cheap.
key_drivers: Guide-embedded H2 deceleration to ~15% y/y vs 25% just printed, by the reporter's own arithmetic on sourced figures
Sector regime punishing multiples even on continued growth (Salesforce, Workday down double digits while still growing); TTAN still 7.5x EV/S, 62x fwd P/E, GAAP-lossmaking
Offsetting: 11.1% short float, 5.26 days to cover, 9% drawdown into print already lowers the bar
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: If the SaaS de-rate is still mid-cycle, a good quarter gets sold anyway, exactly as it did for Salesforce and Workday this year.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Could not source a firm sell-side Q2 revenue consensus; snippets conflict $280-287M.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: 13.14% implied rich vs 9.09% mean-abs history; expect ~8-11%. Direction barely priced-in either way; the vol, not the skew, looks expensive.
key_drivers: Insider selling is routine 10b5-1/sponsor distribution, informationally empty; no open-market purchases but that is base case for this issuer
No negative communication signal: guidance was raised at Q1 print, NDR KPI retained, no 8-Ks or unusual filings since June 18
Positioning washed out (short interest down ~27% in 30 days); options flow call-skewed but not weighted heavily
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Regime beats forensics: in an AI-disruption de-rating a beat-and-raise can be sold anyway if NDR prints at or below 110% or the 'above 110%' phrasing is dropped.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: openinsider.com and fintel.io unreachable; short interest and put/call figures are single-vendor and unverified.

synthesis.move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
synthesis.early_prediction: Panel leans mildly bullish (mean score +15, all seven personas positive but none at Lean-Up strength) on a beat-and-raise setup, but with too little conviction for a directional call; expect a print judged mainly on the size of the FY27 guide raise and GTV growth against a 13.14% implied move that looks rich versus the 9.09% historical mean; main caveat is sector-wide multiple compression that has sold good SaaS prints outright this year even on strong numbers.
synthesis.red_team_survival_note: The red-team case (guide-implied H2 deceleration to ~15% y/y vs 25% just printed, plus a software-sector de-rating that has punished beats at Salesforce and Workday) produced the panel's lowest score (+8) but did not flip sign -- even the skeptic leans mildly positive, muted mainly by reversal risk (55) rather than direction. The thesis survives as a live tail risk (reversal risk 45-62 across all seven personas) rather than a refutation; it is the main reason the panel is confident there is no strong edge, not confident of a direction.

independence_note: Seven isolated subagents; each received only the Phase-0 anchors (ticker, company, event window/session/date, spot+as-of, event-implied move+source, historical realised moves). None saw the stage 2 dossier, its preliminary direction score, another persona's verdict, or the chair's view.
